Data required to create a new admin user in the shopping mall platform.

IShoppingMallGuest.IRequest.description:
Filter parameters for searching and paginating shopping mall guest users.

This schema defines the possible query filters, pagination controls, and sorting options for requesting a paged list of guest users in the shopping mall platform.
These parameters allow rich search scenarios including filtering by guest ID, creation or update timestamps, and soft deletion status.

Fields correspond to the columns and attributes available in the `shopping_mall_guests` Prisma table for precise filtering.

page.description: The current page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

limit.description: The maximum number of records returned per page. Must be between 1 and 100.

search.description: A text search string to match against guest users' identifying attributes.

created_at_from.description: Filter guests created after this timestamp (inclusive). Must be ISO 8601 date-time format.

created_at_to.description: Filter guests created before this timestamp (inclusive). Must be ISO 8601 date-time format.

updated_at_from.description: Filter guests updated after this timestamp (inclusive). Must be ISO 8601 date-time format.

updated_at_to.description: Filter guests updated before this timestamp (inclusive). Must be ISO 8601 date-time format.

deleted_at_is_null.description: Filter by soft deletion status. When true, returns only guests who are not soft-deleted (deleted_at is null). When false, includes soft-deleted guests.

IShoppingMallGuest.description:
Guest users who browse the platform without requiring authentication.

They have a minimal profile and are tracked primarily for session management and audit purposes.

Guest entities do not have login credentials and are intended for transient or anonymous usage.

Soft deletion is supported to allow recording of guest removal without losing historic session data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the guest user. Generated as a UUID.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the guest record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the guest record was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

Authenticated customer session record associated with a registered customer user in the shopping mall platform.

Stores session metadata such as IP address, connection URL, referrer URL, timestamps, and activity status.

This schema maps to the shopping_mall_customer_sessions table in the Prisma database.

All sensitive authentication fields are managed by the server; clients only provide connection metadata during session creation.

IShoppingMallCustomerSession.IUpdate.description:
Update payload for modifying existing shopping mall customer session records.

This schema defines the allowable fields that can be updated for customer sessions including connection metadata such as IP address, origin URL, referrer URL, and expiration timestamp.

This schema excludes immutable properties such as primary keys and creation timestamps, ensuring only mutable session metadata is updated.

ip.description: IP address of the customer session connection. This field is expected to conform to IPv4 or IPv6 address formats and is used for logging and auditing purposes.

referrer.description: Referrer URL from which the customer arrived. This field captures the previous page URL, providing context for user navigation and traffic analysis.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the session expired; null if still active. A null value indicates the session is currently active and has not expired.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page. Defaults to 20 if not specified.

updated_at.description: Timestamp marking the most recent update to the admin user account. Stored in ISO 8601 date-time format.

IShoppingMallAdmin.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating shopping mall admin user information.

All properties are optional allowing partial updates.
Fields include contact updates, avatar changes, and activation status toggling.
Immutable fields such as ID are excluded from this DTO to prevent accidental changes.

name.description: Updated full name of the admin user for display purposes.

email.description: Updated email address used for login and notifications. Changing this requires verification processes.

phone_number.description: Updated contact phone number for the admin user, used for multi-factor authentication or urgent notifications.

avatar_url.description: URL link to an administrative user's avatar image, supporting optional profile pictures. Can be set to null to remove existing avatar.

is_active.description: Flag to enable or disable the admin user account within the management system. Disabled accounts cannot log in.

IShoppingMallAdminSession.description:
Detailed information about a specific admin session associated with an admin user in the shopping mall system.

Sensitive session tokens such as JWT tokens are not exposed in this response schema to safeguard security and privacy.

id.description: Unique identifier of the admin session.

ip.description: IP address from which the admin session originated.

user_agent.description: User agent string of the admin's browser or client.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the admin session was created.

expires_at.description: Timestamp when the session will expire. Null indicates no expiration.

is_active.description: Indicates whether the admin session is currently active.

IShoppingMallAdminSession.ICreate.description:
Payload schema for creating a new admin session record in the shopping_mall_admin_sessions table.

Contains session token, login context, and metadata required for secure session establishment by authenticated admin users.

The admin_id field is excluded from request payload because it comes from the authenticated admin context and as it's a path parameter to avoid security breach and duplication.

token.description: JWT token or session token string for authentication purposes

ip.description: IP address from which the admin logged in. Nullable for some network conditions

user_agent.description: User agent string of the admin's browser or client application

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp of the session token, in ISO 8601 format

IShoppingMallAdminSession.IUpdate.description:
Payload schema for updating an existing admin session record in the shopping_mall_admin_sessions table.

Allows modification of session status, expiration, and metadata by authorized admin users.

Does not allow changing the primary key fields such as admin_id or session id.

session_token.description: Updated session token string or null to invalidate

login_ip.description: Updated login IP address for the session

login_user_agent.description: Updated user agent string for the session

expires_at.description: New expiration timestamp for the session. Use null to expire immediately

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the session was last updated. Auto-managed by the system

IShoppingMallSection.IRequest.description:
Filter and pagination criteria for listing shopping mall sections.

Used to query sections under a specific channel with search, sorting, and pagination options.

Contains optional filters for section name or code matching, and pagination controls.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Must be 1 or greater.

IShoppingMallChannelCategory.ICreate.description:
Request body schema for creating a shopping mall channel category.

Contains the properties required to link an existing product category to a specific shopping mall channel.
This operation requires admin authorization and uses the shopping mall channel code as path parameter to resolve the channel context.

Auto-generated fields and system-managed timestamps are excluded from this creation request.

Includes necessary fields to establish the link and display metadata.

shopping_mall_product_category_id.description: UUID of the product category to link with the shopping mall channel

is_active.description: Flag indicating whether the channel category association is active

display_order.description: Order in which the channel category is displayed relative to others in this channel

oneOf.description: Optional notes or comments about the channel category association

notes.description: Optional notes or comments about the channel category association

IShoppingMallChannelCategory.description:
Detailed shopping mall channel category information.

Represents a specific category that is linked to a particular shopping mall channel, defining its position and role within the channel's categorization hierarchy.

Includes identification properties, references to the channel and product category it belongs to, ordering information, timestamps for auditing, and soft deletion status.

This entity is central to organizing product displays and customer navigation within a channel in the shopping mall platform.

id.description: Unique identifier of the shopping mall channel category record

shopping_mall_channel_code.description: Unique business code of the linked shopping mall channel

shopping_mall_product_category_code.description: Unique business code of the linked shopping mall product category

code.description: Unique business code representing this channel category

name.description: Human-readable name of this channel category

order_index.description: Ordering index to control presentation order in UI, smaller values show first

created_at.description: Timestamp when the record was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the record was soft deleted, or null if not deleted

is_enabled.description: Flag indicating if the category is enabled and should be displayed

is_visible.description: Flag indicating whether the category is publicly visible to customers

oneOf.description: Optional memo or notes regarding this channel category

memo.description: Optional memo or notes regarding this channel category

level.description: Hierarchical level of the category within the channel's category tree, starting from 1

parent_code.description: Business code of the parent category in the hierarchy, or null if none

depth.description: Depth level representing how deep this category is nested within the channel's category hierarchy

path.description: Array representing the path of categories from root to this category

path_codes.description: Array of business codes corresponding to the path of categories

virtual_path.description: Virtual path string for URL routing representing this category's location in the channel hierarchy

virtual_path_codes.description: Virtual path segmented by business codes for routing

is_leaf.description: Flag indicating whether this category has no child categories

is_discounted.description: Indicates if products in this category are subject to discounts

oneOf.description: Controls sales allowance configurations for the category
Controls sales allowance configurations for the category

sales_allowance_expired_at.description: Datetime when sales allowance expires for this category, or null if no expiration

max_virtual_products_per_order.description: Maximum number of virtual products allowed in a single order for this category

memo2.description: Additional memo or notes associated with this category

marketing_comment.description: Marketing comments to promote the category

statistics_count.description: Count of statistics related to this category

statistics_last_updated_at.description: Last time statistics were updated for the category

external_link_url.description: External URL for redirecting consumers, if applicable

use_ADS.description: Flag indicating whether to use advertisements for this category

ad_display_start_at.description: Datetime when advertisement display starts for this category

ad_display_end_at.description: Datetime when advertisement display ends for this category

ad_text_content.description: Text content for advertisements in this category

ad_text_html_content.description: HTML formatted text content for ads in this category

additional_flags.description: Miscellaneous flags in string format for future extension

tags.description: List of tags associated with this category

IShoppingMallChannelCategory.IUpdate.description:
Request schema to update an existing shopping mall channel category. This allows admins to modify the details and association of a product category linked to a specific shopping mall channel.

The update schema includes fields that exist in the Prisma model `shopping_mall_channel_categories` and excludes any phantom properties.

Properties include all mutable fields such as association IDs, display order, notes, and active status, but excludes immutable system-managed fields.

The schema aligns exactly with the Prisma model fields to prevent phantom field errors.

shopping_mall_channel_id.description: UUID of the associated shopping mall channel

shopping_mall_product_category_id.description: UUID of the linked product category

is_active.description: Whether this channel category is currently active and visible in the shopping mall.

display_order.description: Display order relative to other category entries for sorting

oneOf.description: Additional notes associated with the channel category

notes.description: Additional notes associated with the channel category

IShoppingMallConfiguration.IRequest.description: Request schema for searching and filtering shopping mall configuration entries. Supports pagination, sorting, and keyword filters for querying system settings.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

search.description: Search keyword to filter configuration keys and values.

sortBy.description: Field name used for sorting the results.

Sort direction, ascending or descending.

IShoppingMallConfiguration.description:
Configuration setting in the shopping mall system, representing a unique key-value pair controlling system-wide preferences, feature toggles, and operational parameters.

Configurations can be soft deleted and have audit timestamps for creation and updates.

This schema maps directly to the shopping_mall_configurations Prisma model.

id.description: Unique identifier for the configuration entry, serving as the primary key.

key.description: Unique identifier key of the configuration setting.

value.description: Configuration value as a string. Interpretation depends on the context of the key.

oneOf.description: Optional detailed description explaining the purpose and usage of the configuration entry.

description.description: Optional detailed description explaining the purpose and usage of the configuration entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the configuration entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating the last update time of the configuration entry.

oneOf.description: Timestamp indicating when this configuration entry was soft deleted. Null if active.

deletedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this configuration entry was soft deleted. Null if active.

IShoppingMallConfiguration.ICreate.description:
Payload to create a new shopping mall configuration entry.

Requires a unique key and value. Optional description and administrative notes can be provided.

System-managed audit timestamps are excluded from this payload.

key.description: Unique identifier key for the configuration.

value.description: Value to assign to the configuration key.

oneOf.description: Optional description explaining the configuration setting.

description.description: Optional description explaining the configuration setting.

oneOf.description: Flag indicating if the configuration is enabled. Defaults to true if omitted.

enabled.description: Flag indicating if the configuration is enabled. Defaults to true if omitted.

oneOf.description: Internal note for administrative purposes.

IShoppingMallConfiguration.IUpdate.description:
Payload to update an existing shopping mall configuration entry.

Only the 'value' field can be updated through this payload to preserve integrity of keys.

System-managed timestamps and soft deletion are handled separately.

Intended for use by authorized administrative users.

value.description: Updated value for configuration key to reflect new system setting.

IShoppingMallProduct.ICreate.description:
Payload schema for creating a new shopping mall product.

This creation schema excludes system-managed and authentication context fields such as `shopping_mall_seller_id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, and `deleted_at`.

Includes fields for the product code, product name, optional description, and active status flag.

Used in API operations allowing authorized sellers or admins to create products without the ability to override authentication context.

code.description: Unique business code for the product used as a global identifier required during creation.

name.description: The official name of the product to be displayed in the shopping mall catalog.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the product. Can be null if no description is provided.

is_active.description: Flag to set whether the product is active and visible after creation.

IShoppingMallProduct.description:
Represents detailed information of a shopping mall product entity used in customer and guest views.

This schema provides comprehensive details for an individual product identified uniquely by its globally unique productCode.
It includes fundamental product metadata such as code, name, description, activity status, and timestamp fields marking creation, updates, and soft deletion.

Associations to sellers or categories are available through related schemas rather than direct FK fields to prevent security risks and data exposure.

This schema ensures full representation of the product entity fields fetched in a read operation, serving as the response body for product detail retrieval API endpoints.

code.description: Unique business code identifying the product, used globally as an identifier for this shopping mall product.

name.description: Human-readable name of the product displayed to customers.

description.description: Detailed description of the product, can be null if not provided.

is_active.description: Flag indicating whether the product is active and visible within the shopping mall catalog.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the product was initially created in the system.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating the last time the product details were updated.

deleted_at.description: Nullable ISO 8601 timestamp marking when the product was soft deleted, if applicable.

IShoppingMallProduct.IUpdate.description:
Represents the payload used to update an existing product in the shopping mall catalog.

This schema includes properties that can be modified by authorized users to keep product details current.

Fields such as product name, description, and activity status can be updated.

Ownership and creation timestamps are immutable and thus excluded from this schema.

The schema enforces constraints ensuring valid updates in line with business rules and database integrity.

This type supports partial updates, allowing users to modify specific fields without affecting others.

name.description: Product name displayed to customers and used in listings.

description.description: Detailed product description providing in-depth information for customers and administrators. May be set to null to remove the existing description.

is_active.description: Indicates if the product is currently active and visible in the catalog. Active products are considered available for sale.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1.

limit.description: Number of items to return per page.

search.description: Search keyword to filter SKUs by code or description.

sort_by.description: Field to sort SKUs by. Example values: 'price', 'inventory', 'created_at'.

oneOf.description: Sort order: ascending (asc) or descending (desc).
Sort order: ascending (asc) or descending (desc).

filters.description: Filter criteria for SKUs, such as active status or price range.

is_active.description: Filter SKUs by active status. True to include only active SKUs.

IShoppingMallProductSku.IRequest.description: Parameters to filter and paginate the list of shopping mall product SKUs.

id.description: Unique identifier of the SKU.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Foreign key referencing the parent product.

sku_code.description: Unique SKU code for inventory and order processing.

price.description: Sales price of this SKU variant.

inventory.description: Current inventory count for the SKU.

is_active.description: Indicates if the SKU is currently active and available for sale.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the SKU was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the SKU was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the SKU was soft-deleted. Null if not deleted.

IShoppingMallProductSku.description: SKU variants of products in the shopping mall platform representing specific configurations with pricing and inventory details.

IShoppingMallProductSku.ICreate.description:
Schema for creating a new Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) variant under a specific product in the shopping mall platform.

Represents the input data required to define a unique SKU variant associated with an existing product, including SKU code, price, inventory quantity, and active status.

Security: The seller's identity is derived from the authenticated context and must not be included here.

sku_code.description: Unique SKU code used for inventory and order processing. Must be unique across all SKUs for the product and follow the platform's SKU format guidelines.

price.description: Sales price of this SKU variant in the store's currency. Must be a non-negative number representing the selling price.

inventory.description: Current stock inventory count available for this SKU variant. Must be a non-negative integer reflecting physical inventory.

is_active.description: Indicates whether this SKU is active and available for sale. True means the SKU is available; false means it is inactive or discontinued.

IShoppingMallProductSku.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating existing product SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) in the shopping mall platform.

Allows modification of SKU details including pricing, stock levels, variant attributes, and activation status.

Authorization: Only authenticated sellers who own the product can update its SKUs.

Excludes seller identity fields as they are injected from authentication context.

price.description: Sale price of the SKU in USD. Must be non-negative.

inventory.description: Available stock quantity for the SKU. Must be zero or positive.

is_active.description: Activation status indicating whether the SKU is currently available for sale.

name.description: Unique SKU code identifier for this product variant. Maximum 50 characters.

IShoppingMallProductCategory.IRequest.description:
Request DTO to filter and paginate shopping mall product categories.

Field to sort by, either name or creation date

IShoppingMallProductCategory.description:
Represents a shopping mall product category entity.

Describes the properties of a product category used for classification of products in the shopping mall. Each category has a unique code and descriptive name. Categories may have hierarchical relationships managed through other operations.

This includes audit fields for creation and update timestamps.

Sensitive fields and ownership references are omitted for security and design consistency.

id.description: Unique identifier of the product category, usually UUID

code.description: Unique business code identifying the category

name.description: Display name of the category

oneOf.description: Optional additional descriptive text about the category

oneOf.description: Timestamp of last record update

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last record update

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp indicating when the category was deleted, if applicable

version.description: Optimistic lock version number for concurrency control

IShoppingMallProductCategory.ICreate.description:
Request body schema for creating a new shopping mall product category.

Includes necessary properties to uniquely identify and describe the category. The `code` is a unique identifier used as business key. The `name` provides a descriptive title. Description is optional to allow further details about the category.

code.description: Unique business identifier code for the product category

name.description: Display name of the product category

oneOf.description: Optional detailed description of the product category

description.description: Optional detailed description of the product category

IShoppingMallProductCategory.IUpdate.description:
Request body schema for updating an existing shopping mall product category.

This schema allows updating mutable fields of a product category. Immutable or system-managed fields like 'id', 'code', and audit timestamps have been removed to prevent inappropriate modification. Optional fields support partial updates.

Soft deletion can be performed by setting the 'deleted_at' field.

All properties are optional to allow flexibility in updates.

name.description: New display name for the product category

description.description: Updated detailed description

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Setting this marks the category as deleted

version.description: Record version for optimistic locking. Allows safe concurrency control during updates.

IShoppingMallShoppingCart.description:
Detailed information about a shopping cart in the shopping mall platform.

Represents a customer's shopping cart including session details and references to customer information as well as cart items if applicable.

This object reflects the shopping_mall_shopping_carts table from the Prisma schema and includes necessary metadata for client and backend processing.

Sensitive details are omitted. Ownership fields come from the authenticated customer's session context and are therefore excluded from direct input.

IShoppingMallWishlist.description:
Represents a customer's wishlist in the shopping mall platform, containing saved products for future purchase.

Includes fields for identification, ownership, status, and timestamps for tracking creation and modification.

Represents an item saved by a customer in their wishlist within the shopping mall platform.

Each wishlist item references a specific product and includes details such as quantity and attributes relevant for the customer’s future purchase intent.

IShoppingMallOrder.description:
Represents an individual order placed by a customer in the e-commerce shopping mall system.

This schema corresponds to the `shopping_mall_orders` database model, which tracks order metadata, customer reference, status, payment information, and lifecycle timestamps. Soft deletion is supported via the optional `deleted_at` field.

The object includes associations, but actor-based fields (such as customer ID from JWT) are excluded from request DTOs and handled by the authentication system.

Used in responses to provide full order details.

id.description: Unique identifier of the order as primary key.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Reference to the customer who placed the order.

order_number.description: Unique business order number used for external references.

status.description: Current status of the order, such as `pending`, `processing`, `shipped`, `delivered`, or `cancelled`.

payment_status.description: Current payment status for the order indicating if payment is pending, completed, or failed.

total_amount.description: Total monetary amount for the order including taxes, fees, and discounts.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the order was initially created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the order was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Optional soft deletion timestamp indicating when the order was logically deleted.

order_number.description: Unique business order number for external reference.

status.description: Current order status such as pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled.

payment_status.description: Payment status indicating whether payment is pending, completed, or failed.

total_amount.description: Total amount of the order including taxes, fees, and discounts.

IShoppingMallOrder.ICreate.description:
Request body DTO for creating a new shopping mall order.

Contains the necessary information to create the order excluding the primary key, timestamps, and customer ID which is inferred from the authenticated customer context.

IShoppingMallOrder.IUpdate.description:
Data transfer object for updating an existing shopping mall order.

Allows modification of order status, payment status, total amount, and timestamps that reflect order lifecycle changes. Ownership and customer reference fields are excluded as they are immutable or managed via authentication context.

Timestamps like `created_at` are managed by the system and cannot be changed via this DTO.

All fields are optional, allowing partial updates.

order_number.description: Unique business order number for external reference. Typically immutable and not meant to be changed by this DTO but included for completeness.

status.description: Current order status indicating stage in the order lifecycle such as pending, processing, shipped, delivered, or cancelled.

payment_status.description: Payment status showing if payment has been completed, is pending, or has failed.

total_amount.description: Total monetary amount of the order including taxes, fees, and discounts.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the order was last updated, reflecting status or details changes.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp indicating if the order has been logically deleted. Null means active. This field is managed by the system or admin processes.

This request schema enables filtering, sorting, and pagination capabilities for order items related to a given order. It is used primarily by customers to efficiently query and navigate the detailed SKUs within their orders.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.description:
Individual items included in customer orders in the shopping mall platform.

This entity represents each SKU included in an order, specifying the quantity, unit price at order time, and current status of the order item.

It includes references to the parent shopping mall order and the specific product SKU. It tracks creation and update timestamps for auditing and order lifecycle management.

id.description: Primary key unique identifier for the order item.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: Reference to the parent shopping mall order's unique identifier.

shopping_mall_product_sku_id.description: Reference to the unique identifier of the product SKU included in the order.

quantity.description: The number of units of the SKU ordered in this order item. Must be a positive integer.

unit_price.description: Unit price of one SKU unit at the time the order was placed, represented as a double precision floating point number.

status.description: Current status of the order item, such as pending, shipped, or returned. Values should correspond to the business workflow and status definitions.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp indicating when this order item record was created.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp indicating the last time this order item record was updated.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating an existing shopping mall order item record.

Allows changes to the quantity, unit price, and status fields of an existing order item. This DTO excludes immutable fields such as identifiers and timestamps.

Designed for PATCH or PUT requests, all properties are optional to allow partial updates.

quantity.description: Updated quantity of the SKU units included in this order item.

unit_price.description: Updated unit price for the SKU units at the time of order modification.

status.description: Updated status of the order item, reflecting workflow progress such as processing, shipped, returned, or cancelled.

IShoppingMallShipment.description:
Shipment records for orders in the shopping mall platform.

Tracks shipment status, shipping method, tracking numbers, and timestamps.
Shipments are linked to orders and enable shipment lifecycle tracking.
Soft deletion supported for shipment data management.

id.description: Primary key of the shipment.

shoppingMallOrderId.description: Reference to the order being shipped. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

trackingNumber.description: Shipment tracking number provided by the carrier.

status.description: Shipment status such as pending, shipped, in_transit, delivered.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of last update on shipment record.

IShoppingMallShipment.ICreate.description:
Information needed to create a new shipment record including associated order, shipping method, tracking number, and shipment status.

This schema aligns exactly with the underlying Prisma model for shipments, ensuring proper linkage to the related order and correct usage of status fields.

Fields:
- shoppingMallOrderId: UUID of the associated order.
- shippingMethod: Specifies the shipping carrier or method used.
- trackingNumber: Optional tracking number from the carrier.
- status: Current status of the shipment such as pending, shipped, in_transit, delivered, returned, or cancelled.

shoppingMallOrderId.description: Unique identifier of the order associated with this shipment.

IShoppingMallOrderCancellation.description:
Represents a customer's order cancellation request in the shopping mall platform.

This entity tracks the details of cancellation requests including the associated order and customer, reasons for cancellation, status, and timestamps for creation, update, and soft deletion.

Used to monitor and manage the lifecycle of order cancellation workflows, enabling customer service and administrative processes.

Fields:
- id: Unique identifier for the cancellation request.
- shopping_mall_order_id: Reference to the order being canceled.
- shopping_mall_customer_id: Reference to the customer requesting cancellation.
- reason: Optional text describing the customer's reason for cancellation.
- status: Current status of the cancellation request (e.g., pending, approved, rejected).
- created_at: Timestamp when the request was created.
- updated_at: Timestamp when the request was last updated.
- deleted_at: Optional timestamp marking soft deletion of the request.

status.description: Refund status. Must be one of the valid refund state enums.

oneOf.description: Date and time when the refund was approved or denied. Null if not decided yet.

approved_at.description: Date and time when the refund was approved or denied. Null if not decided yet.

approval_note.description: Notes or comments added by the administrator during refund approval process.

IShoppingMallCoupon.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for querying shopping mall coupons.

Supports filtering, sorting, paging with optional fields for advanced search capabilities.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based).

limit.description: Number of records per page.

IShoppingMallCoupon.description:
Comprehensive details of a marketing coupon managed within the shopping mall platform.

Captures all essential attributes such as code, discount configuration, validity intervals, and usage constraints.

System fields for creation, update, and soft deletion timestamps provide audit capabilities.

id.description: Unique identifier of the coupon record.

code.description: Unique coupon code for business operations and customer use.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the coupon's terms, applicable conditions, and usage notes.

oneOf.description: Coupon offers a fixed amount off.
Coupon offers a percentage discount.

discount_type.description: Defines the nature of the discount applied by the coupon.

discount_value.description: Numeric value representing the discount amount or percentage.

oneOf.description: Threshold order amount for coupon applicability, nullable.

minimum_order_amount.description: Minimum order value required to apply the coupon.

oneOf.description: Upper limit on discount amount provided by the coupon, nullable.

maximum_discount_amount.description: Caps the maximum discount to prevent excessive reductions.

start_at.description: Timestamp marking when the coupon becomes valid.

end_at.description: Timestamp after which the coupon expires and is no longer valid.

oneOf.description: Global cap on how many times the coupon may be used.

usage_limit.description: Sets the maximum total redemptions allowed.

oneOf.description: Limit on how many times each customer can redeem the coupon.

per_customer_limit.description: Restricts coupon use per individual customer.

status.description: Current operational state of the coupon, e.g., active, expired, or disabled.

created_at.description: Record creation timestamp for auditing.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the coupon.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating if and when the coupon was logically deleted.

IShoppingMallCoupon.ICreate.description:
This schema defines the attributes required to create a new shopping mall coupon in the platform.

It includes coupon code, discount type, discount value, usage limits, validity period, and status. The schema aligns exactly with the underlying shopping_mall_coupons Prisma table for consistency and correctness.

Required fields ensure data completeness for creating valid promotional coupons.

code.description: Unique coupon code used by customers during checkout to apply discounts.

description.description: Detailed description of the coupon's terms, conditions, and intended usage.

oneOf.description: Indicates a fixed amount discount applied by the coupon.
Indicates a percentage-based discount applied by the coupon.

discount_type.description: Type of discount provided by the coupon, either fixed amount or percentage.

discount_value.description: Amount of discount, expressed as a fixed value or percentage depending on discount type.

oneOf.description: Minimum order amount required to apply this coupon. Null indicates no minimum.
No minimum order amount set for this coupon.

minimum_order_amount.description: The minimum order amount that must be met to use the coupon.

oneOf.description: Maximum discount amount the coupon can provide if applicable. Null indicates no cap.
No maximum discount amount set for this coupon.

maximum_discount_amount.description: Caps the discount amount applicable by this coupon to prevent excessive discounts.

start_at.description: ISO8601 date-time when the coupon becomes valid and usable.

end_at.description: ISO8601 date-time when the coupon expires and becomes invalid.

oneOf.description: Maximum total times this coupon may be redeemed across all customers.
No usage limit set, coupon can be redeemed unlimited times.

usage_limit.description: Total usage limit applied globally to this coupon.

oneOf.description: Maximum number of times a single customer can redeem this coupon.
No per-customer limit on redemption count.

per_customer_limit.description: Usage limit per customer to prevent abuse.

status.description: Current status of the coupon, such as active, expired, or disabled.

IShoppingMallCoupon.IUpdate.description:
Schema for updating an existing shopping mall coupon.

Allows authorized administrators to update discount details, validity period, usage limits, and status. Coupon identity is conveyed via path parameter; thus, code is excluded from update body.

Nullable fields accept explicit null values for flexible updates.

oneOf.description: Coupon discount type is a fixed amount.
Coupon discount type is a percentage value.

discount_type.description: Type of discount the coupon offers; fixed amount or percentage.

discount_value.description: Discount amount provided by the coupon.

oneOf.description: Minimum order amount threshold for coupon applicability.
No minimum order amount is required.

minimum_order_amount.description: Minimum purchase amount condition for applying the coupon.

oneOf.description: Cap on maximum discount amount for the coupon.
No maximum discount amount cap.

maximum_discount_amount.description: Upper limit on the discount amount available via the coupon.

start_at.description: Starting date and time when the coupon becomes valid.

end_at.description: Ending date and time when the coupon expires.

oneOf.description: Total number of times the coupon can be used globally.
Unlimited total number of uses.
Limit on number of times a single customer can use the coupon.
No limit per individual customer.

status.description: Current state of the coupon, e.g., active or disabled.

description.description: Text describing the coupon details and usage instructions.

IShoppingMallCouponRedemption.IRequest.description:
Request body schema for searching and filtering coupon redemptions in the shopping mall platform.

Allows administrators to specify pagination options, sorting criteria, and complex filters to retrieve paginated lists of coupon redemptions associated with a specific coupon code. Supports filtering by customer, redemption date, order status, and other relevant fields.

Ensures secure access by restricting to authorized admin users and validating all inputs against schema constraints.

page.description: Page number for paginated results; must be greater than 0.

limit.description: Number of items per page in paginated results; maximum 100.

oneOf.description: Field by which to sort redemption results.
Field by which to sort redemption results.
Field by which to sort redemption results.

sort_by.description: Field by which to sort redemption results.

oneOf.description: Sort order: ascending or descending.
Sort order: ascending or descending.

customer_name.description: Optional filter for redemption records corresponding to customers with matching names.

order_id.description: Optional filter by associated order ID.

start_date.description: Filter for redemptions made on or after this date/time.

end_date.description: Filter for redemptions made on or before this date/time.

IShoppingMallCouponRedemption.description:
Represents a record of a coupon redemption by a customer, linked to a specific order in the shopping mall system.

This object includes identifiers for the coupon, customer, order, and tracks redemption amount and timestamps, supporting audit and compliance.

id.description: Primary unique identifier of the coupon redemption record.

coupon.description: The coupon that was redeemed by the customer.

customer.description: The customer who redeemed the coupon.

order.description: The order associated with the coupon redemption.

redeemed_amount.description: The discount amount successfully redeemed during this coupon usage. Cannot exceed coupon value.

redeemed_at.description: Timestamp of when this coupon redemption took place (ISO 8601 format).

created_at.description: Record creation timestamp.

updated_at.description: Record last update timestamp.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp indicating logical deletion of the redemption record, if applicable.

IShoppingMallCouponRedemption.ICreate.description:
Represents the data required to create a new coupon redemption record in the shopping mall platform.

This schema includes essential properties such as redemption_date, status, and optional notes necessary to enforce coupon usage rules and validate redemptions.

Authentication context fields such as customer ID and coupon ID are removed from client input and injected by the backend using path parameters and session information, preventing impersonation vulnerabilities.

redemption_date.description: Timestamp indicating when the coupon was redeemed. Format follows ISO 8601 date-time standards.

oneOf.description: Current status of the coupon redemption. Indicates if it is pending, completed, or cancelled.
Current status of the coupon redemption. Indicates if it is pending, completed, or cancelled.
Current status of the coupon redemption. Indicates if it is pending, completed, or cancelled.

status.description: Current status of the coupon redemption. Indicates if it is pending, completed, or cancelled.

oneOf.description: Optional notes or comments related to the coupon redemption. Can be used for administrative purposes or auditing.

notes.description: Optional notes or comments related to the coupon redemption. Can be used for administrative purposes or auditing.

IShoppingMallCouponRedemption.IUpdate.description: Update data for a coupon redemption record. Allows modification of redemption status while maintaining data integrity and preventing unauthorized changes.

redeemed_amount.description: The discount amount successfully redeemed during this coupon usage. Cannot exceed coupon value.

IShoppingMallCoin.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering shopping mall coin transaction records.

Allows filtering by customer, mall channel, date range, and pagination controls.

Supports sorting and limiting of results based on business rules.

Used by administrative APIs to manage customer coin balances securely.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting at 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page. Limits server load and response size.

search.description: Search keyword to filter coin records based on matching customer or transaction info.

orderBy.description: Field name to sort the coin records, e.g., 'created_at' or 'amount'.

oneOf.description: Direction of ordering: ascending or descending.
Direction of ordering: ascending or descending.

orderDirection.description: Direction of ordering: ascending or descending.

IShoppingMallCoin.description:
Represents a coin entity owned by a customer in the shopping mall platform.

This entity includes the coin type details, amount available, and associations to both the shopping mall channel and the customer who owns the coin balance.

Soft deletion is supported via the optional `deleted_at` field to allow reversible removal and audit trails.

Timestamps track creation and last update times for synchronization and audit purposes.

id.description: Unique identifier of the shopping mall coin

shopping_mall_channel_id.description: Unique identifier of the shopping mall channel to which this coin belongs

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer owning this coin balance

code.description: Unique code representing the coin type

name.description: Display name of the coin

oneOf.description: Status of the coin: active status indicates the coin is valid for use.
Status of the coin: inactive status indicates the coin is temporarily disabled.
Status of the coin: suspended status indicates the coin is suspended due to policy violations or other reasons.

status.description: Status of the coin (active, inactive, or suspended)

created_at.description: Timestamp when the coin was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the coin was last updated

deleted_at.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null if the record is active.

IShoppingMallCoin.ICreate.description:
Request body to create a new shopping mall coin entity.

Requires specifying coin type code, display name, amount, and status.

System-managed fields such as id, shopping_mall_channel_id, shopping_mall_customer_id, and timestamps must not be included in the creation payload because they are injected by the server.

Soft deletion timestamp is managed by the system and never accepted from clients.

code.description: Unique code representing the coin type

name.description: Display name of the coin

amount.description: Integer amount of coins to create

oneOf.description: Status of the coin: active status indicates the coin is valid for use.
Status of the coin: inactive status indicates the coin is temporarily disabled.
Status of the coin: suspended status indicates the coin is suspended due to policy violations or other reasons.

status.description: Status of the coin (active, inactive, or suspended)

shopping_mall_channel_id.description: Removed - security-sensitive field injected by server

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Removed - security-sensitive field injected by server

IShoppingMallCoin.IUpdate.description: Schema for updating a shopping mall coin record. Allows modification of coin attributes excluding immutable fields like id and ownership fields. Ensures secure update operations by validating only allowed mutable properties.

amount.description: The amount of the coin. Represents the current balance or value. Must be a non-negative integer.

oneOf.description: Status of the coin (active, inactive, or suspended)
Status of the coin (active, inactive, or suspended)
Status of the coin (active, inactive, or suspended)

status.description: Status of the coin (active, inactive, or suspended)

IShoppingMallMileageTransaction.IRequest.description: Request parameters for querying and paginating shopping mall mileage transaction records. Includes filtering based on customer, transaction type, date ranges, and supports pagination and sorting capabilities.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

limit.description: Number of records per page for pagination. Defaults to 20 and capped to prevent system overload.

customer_id.description: Optional filter to restrict transactions to a specific customer ID. Can be null to disable filtering.

transaction_type.description: Filter transactions based on the transaction type: 'earn', 'use', or 'expire'. Can be null to include all types.

start_date.description: Start datetime for filtering transactions. Inclusive. Can be null if no start filter.

end_date.description: End datetime for filtering transactions. Inclusive. Can be null if no end filter.

sort_by.description: Field to sort the transaction list by. Allowed values are 'date' or 'amount'. Defaults to 'date' if null.

order.description: Sort order direction: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending. Defaults to 'desc' if null.

IShoppingMallMileageTransaction.description:
Represents a mileage transaction record in the shopping mall platform, capturing points earned or spent by customers, associated order references, and the transaction status.

This DTO includes full reference objects for related entities to provide complete transactional context without requiring additional API queries.

The atomic operation principle is enforced by including full nested reference objects for belongs-to relations and excluding raw foreign key fields.

id.description: Unique identifier for the mileage transaction in UUID format.

transaction_type.description: Type of mileage transaction (e.g., earning, spending).

points.description: Number of points involved in the transaction.

description.description: Detailed description or memo for the mileage transaction.

status.description: Current status of the mileage transaction, such as pending or completed.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the mileage transaction was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the mileage transaction was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

customer.description: Associated customer details as a summary type providing key information without circular references.

order.description: Associated order details as a summary type providing essential information without creating cycles.

IShoppingMallMileageTransaction.ICreate.description:
Request body schema for creating a new mileage transaction record in the shopping mall platform.

Includes unique code reference fields for related entities rather than raw UUIDs to enhance readability and coherence with endpoint path parameters.

customer_code.description: Unique code identifier for the customer associated with this mileage transaction. Used in lieu of customer_id UUID.

transaction_type.description: Type of mileage transaction (e.g., earn, spend). Accepted values include 'earn', 'use', and 'expire'.

points.description: Number of points earned or spent in this transaction.

description.description: Description or memo for the mileage transaction.

status.description: Status of the mileage transaction at creation, such as 'pending' or 'completed'.

order_code.description: Optional unique code identifier for the associated order if applicable. Used as a reference instead of raw UUID.

IShoppingMallMileageTransaction.IUpdate.description: Request schema for updating a mileage transaction in the shopping mall system. Includes all modifiable fields while excluding creator and system managed properties.

status.description: Status of the mileage transaction, e.g., 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'.

points.description: Amount of mileage points changed in this transaction (positive for addition, negative for deduction).

oneOf.description: Optional textual description or note for the transaction.

description.description: Optional textual description or note for the transaction.

IShoppingMallCustomerInquiry.IRequest.description: Request schema for searching and paginating customer inquiries in the shopping mall system. Allows filtering, sorting, and pagination based on inquiry fields.

page.description: Page number for pagination (starting from 1).

limit.description: Number of items per page for pagination.

oneOf.description: Keyword to search inquiries by customer name, email, or inquiry content.

search.description: Keyword to search inquiries by customer name, email, or inquiry content.

oneOf.description: Filter inquiries by their status (e.g., open, closed, pending).

oneOf.description: End date for filtering inquiries based on submission date.

end_date.description: End date for filtering inquiries based on submission date.

IShoppingMallCustomerInquiry.description:
Detailed information about customer inquiries submitted in the shopping mall platform.

Represents the customer's support questions, issues, or feedback, along with status tracking and timestamps.
This entity is linked to authenticated customers and their sessions, supporting inquiry lifecycle management.

This schema is used in retrieval responses, displaying detailed fields such as title, body, status, and audit information.

id.description: Unique identifier of the customer inquiry

customer_id.description: Reference to the customer who submitted the inquiry

oneOf.description: Reference to the customer session during inquiry submission, if available

session_id.description: Reference to the customer session during inquiry submission, if available

title.description: Title or subject of the inquiry

body.description: Detailed content of the customer inquiry

Current status of the inquiry reflecting its lifecycle stage
Current status of the inquiry reflecting its lifecycle stage
Current status of the inquiry reflecting its lifecycle stage

status.description: Current status of the inquiry reflecting its lifecycle stage

created_at.description: Timestamp when the inquiry was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the inquiry was last updated

IShoppingMallCustomerInquiry.ICreate.description:
Payload for creating a new customer inquiry in the shopping mall platform.

Allows authenticated customers to submit questions, feedback, or complaints.
Fields include inquiry title and body content. Ownership and timestamps are populated from the authenticated session context.
Excludes system fields such as id, created_at, and updated_at, as these are automatically handled by the backend.

The 'status' field defaults to 'open' upon creation and is therefore optional.

title.description: Title or subject of the new customer inquiry

body.description: Detailed content of the inquiry to be submitted

oneOf.description: Initial status of the inquiry, defaults to 'open' if not specified
Initial status of the inquiry, defaults to 'open' if not specified
Initial status of the inquiry, defaults to 'open' if not specified
Initial status of the inquiry, defaults to 'open' if not specified

body.description: Detailed content describing the customer's question or issue

oneOf.description: Current status of the inquiry lifecycle
Current status of the inquiry lifecycle

Current status of the inquiry lifecycle

status.description: Current status of the inquiry lifecycle

ip.description: Client IP address for the current session, optional

href.description: Current page URL for session context

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating previous page for session context

IShoppingMallFaq.description:
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) are a curated collection of common questions and detailed answers designed to support customers with self-service information. Each FAQ entry is a standalone knowledge base article within the shopping mall platform.

This schema defines the FAQ entity including the question text, comprehensive answer content, and essential timestamps for creation and last modification tracking. These entries enable users to quickly find resolutions without direct support interaction.

The FAQ entries support auditing and soft deletion via timestamp fields.

Used in detailed FAQ retrieval operations.

id.description: Unique identifier of the FAQ entry. Generated as a UUID ensuring global uniqueness.

question.description: The question title or topic summarizing the customer's inquiry. Presented to users in FAQ listings for quick scanning.

answer.description: Comprehensive answer providing guidance, instructions, or solutions addressing the customer's question. Supports detailed text including formatting markup if applicable.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking when the FAQ entry was first created. Used for auditing and sorting purposes.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating the most recent update to the FAQ content. Helps track content freshness and revision history.

IShoppingMallFaq.ICreate.description: Data structure for creating a new FAQ entry in the shopping mall platform. Contains the question and the answer fields to define the FAQ content.

question.description: The question text for the new FAQ entry.

answer.description: The answer content for the new FAQ entry.

IShoppingMallFaq.IUpdate.description: Data structure for updating an existing FAQ entry in the shopping mall platform. Contains modifiable fields such as question and answer.

question.description: The FAQ question text, providing the queried topic or issue relevant to the shopping mall customers.

answer.description: The FAQ answer content responding to the question, typically including detailed explanations or solutions.

IShoppingMallFavoriteProduct.IRequest.description: Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering customer's favorite products in the shopping mall platform.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting at 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page, with a maximum limit of 100.

search.description: Optional text search to filter favorite products by matching text in product names or descriptions.

oneOf.description: Field by which to sort the results. Allows sorting by product name or creation date.
Field by which to sort the results. Allows sorting by product name or creation date.

Sort order direction: ascending or descending.

IShoppingMallFavoriteProduct.description:
Represents a user's favorite product entry in the shopping mall platform.

This entity captures the association between a customer and their marked favorite product. It stores relational information to the customer, the product, and the session during which the favorite was created or updated.

It is used for managing and retrieving favorite product data for personalized user interactions and shopping experiences.

id.description: Unique identifier of the favorite product entry.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Identifier of the customer who marked the product as favorite.

shopping_mall_customer_session_id.description: Identifier of the customer session during which the favorite action was recorded. Null if not available.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Identifier of the product marked as favorite.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the favorite entry was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the favorite entry was last updated.

IShoppingMallFavoriteProduct.ICreate.description:
Payload schema for creating a new favorite product entry.

This schema is used by authenticated customers to add a product to their favorites list. The authenticated customer's identity is injected by the backend, so the customer ID is not accepted here.

The payload requires specifying the product being favorited only; session context field removed for security.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Identifier of the product to be added to favorites.

IShoppingMallFavoriteProduct.IUpdate.description:
Payload for updating a favorite product entry in the shopping mall platform.

Allows an authenticated customer to modify mutable fields such as personal notes or display order related to their favorite product list.

Actor fields like customer identifiers are excluded as these are derived from the authenticated session context.

ID path parameter is server-managed and must not be present in update payload.

note.description: Optional personal note attached by the customer to this favorite product.

priority.description: Integer value indicating the display priority or sort order within the customer's favorite products.

IShoppingMallFavoriteSeller.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for retrieving a filtered list of favorite sellers in the shopping mall platform.

Supports fields for pagination, filtering, and sorting to efficiently query favorite sellers associated with the authenticated customer.

page.description: Page number for pagination starting from 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page, capped at 100.

search.description: Optional full-text search term to filter sellers by name or description.

oneOf.description: Field by which to sort the results.
Field by which to sort the results.

order_by.description: Field by which to sort the results.

oneOf.description: Direction of sorting: ascending or descending.
Direction of sorting: ascending or descending.

order_direction.description: Direction of sorting: ascending or descending.

IShoppingMallFavoriteSeller.description:
Represents a favorite seller entry linking a customer to a specific seller in the shopping mall platform.

This schema provides the direct IDs referencing associated customer and seller records.

Created and updated timestamps track record lifecycle.

Used throughout the platform to manage and query favorite seller relationships.

id.description: Unique identifier of the favorite seller record

created_at.description: Timestamp when the favorite seller was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the favorite seller record was last updated

customerId.description: Foreign key to the customer who owns this favorite seller entry

sellerId.description: Foreign key to the seller who is favorited

customer.description: Summary information about the customer who owns this favorite seller entry

seller.description: Summary information about the seller who is favorited

IShoppingMallFavoriteSeller.ICreate.description: Request body to create a new favorite seller link for the authenticated customer. The customer_id is derived from the authentication context and must not be included in the request.

seller_id.description: Unique identifier of the seller to favorite

IShoppingMallFavoriteSeller.IUpdate.description: Update data for favorite seller record. Fields that can be changed by the authenticated customer.

notes.description: Additional notes or remarks about the favorite seller from the customer's perspective.

is_active.description: Flag indicating whether the favorite seller is currently active or disabled by the customer.

IShoppingMallArticle.description:
Represents a shopping mall article entity created by authenticated customers.

This entity includes original article content, category association, author metadata, creations and update timestamps, and counts of related comments and likes. It supports rich text bodies and categorization.

Used for article creation, update, retrieval, and list display purposes.

The shoppingMallArticleCategory property replaces the shoppingMallArticleCategoryCode FK string with an object reference providing summary details about the article's category.

The shoppingMallCustomer property replaces the shoppingMallCustomerId FK string with an object reference providing summary details about the authoring customer.

shoppingMallArticleId.description: Unique UUID identifier for the shopping mall article.

title.description: Title of the shopping mall article, unique per author.

body.description: Rich text content of the article body.

shoppingMallArticleCategory.description: Summary information of the category associated with this article, replacing the raw category code foreign key.

shoppingMallCustomer.description: Summary information of the customer who authored this article, replacing the raw customer UUID foreign key.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the article was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the article was last updated.

commentsCount.description: Total number of comments on this article.

likesCount.description: Total number of likes on this article.

IShoppingMallArticle.ICreate.description:
Request body schema for creating a new shopping mall article.

Includes all necessary fields except for system-generated identifiers and timestamps, which are managed by the backend.

The authenticated customer user will be automatically associated with the created article instance, so their identifier must NOT be included here.

Fields include article title, body content, and category selection.

Used in POST operations to create new articles.

shoppingMallArticleCategoryCode.description: The unique code representing the category the new article will belong to.

body.description: Main content of the new article.

IShoppingMallArticleCategory.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for shopping mall article categories.

Allows clients to filter, sort, and paginate the hierarchical article categories in the shopping mall platform efficiently.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starts from 1.

limit.description: Number of categories per page for pagination, maximum 100.

oneOf.description: Search keyword to filter article categories by matching name or description. Null disables keyword filtering.

search.description: Search keyword to filter article categories by matching name or description. Null disables keyword filtering.

oneOf.description: Filter categories to those with this specific parent category UUID. Null disables filtering by parent.

parent_id.description: Filter categories to those with this specific parent category UUID. Null disables filtering by parent.

oneOf.description: Field used to sort categories. Typically 'name' or 'created_at'. Null disables sorting.

sort_by.description: Field used to sort categories. Typically 'name' or 'created_at'. Null disables sorting.

oneOf.description: Sort order direction: ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc'). Null disables sorting.
Sort order direction: ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc'). Null disables sorting.

sort_order.description: Sort order direction: ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc'). Null disables sorting.

IShoppingMallArticleCategory.description:
Represents a shopping mall article category for organizing articles hierarchically.

Each category includes an identifier, name, optional description, timestamps, and a hierarchical parent-child relationship.

This entity ensures articles can be categorized and navigated effectively within the shopping mall platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the article category.

name.description: Name of the article category. Must be unique within the shopping mall.

oneOf.description: Optional detailed description of the article category.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the article category.

oneOf.description: UUID of the parent category if this category is nested; null if a root category.

parent_id.description: UUID of the parent category if this category is nested; null if a root category.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the category was created.

oneOf.description: Timestamp when the category was last updated; null if never updated.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the category was last updated; null if never updated.

IShoppingMallAdmin.ISummary.description:

IShoppingMallSection.ISummary.description: A concise summary of a shopping mall section representing a logical subdivision within a shopping mall channel. updated_at.description: Timestamp when the SKU was last updated.

IShoppingMallProductCategory.ISummary.description:

IShoppingMallSkuOptionGroup.ISummary.description:

IShoppingMallPayment.ISummary.description:

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the payment record was last updated.

IShoppingMallShipment.ISummary.description:
Summary information of a shipment record in the shopping mall platform.

This schema provides key details such as shipment id, associated order, current status, shipping address, and timestamps.
It is used in list views or summaries where detailed shipment tracking information is not required.

IShoppingMallCoupon.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a shopping mall coupon.

This schema provides key information about a coupon used in the shopping mall platform for marketing and discount purposes.
It includes critical data like coupon code, discount details, status, validity periods, usage limits, and lifecycle timestamps.

This summary is used for listing coupons in administrative or public views where detailed usage logs and restrictions are not needed.

### Business Context
Coupons provide discounts to customers based on different business rules, such as minimum order amounts or maximum discount caps.
They can be limited in total usage and may be soft deleted without physical removal.

### Fields Added
Additional fields reflecting the complete Prisma model were added to ensure thorough representation:
- description
- discount_type
- discount_value
- minimum_order_amount
- maximum_discount_amount
- usage_limit
- created_at
- updated_at
- deleted_at

### Usage
Used in UI listings, API summaries, and reports where concise but comprehensive coupon information is needed.

id.description: Unique identifier of the coupon.

code.description: Unique coupon code customers use at checkout to apply discounts.

discount_rate.description: Calculated percentage discount derived from discount_value and discount_type.

oneOf.description: Coupon is active and can be used.
Coupon validity period has expired.
Coupon has reached usage limit or been fully used.
Coupon is inactive and unavailable for use.

status.description: Current status of the coupon indicating if it is active, expired, used, or inactive.

valid_from.description: The timestamp from which the coupon becomes valid and usable.

valid_until.description: The timestamp after which the coupon expires and cannot be used.

description.description: Textual description outlining the promotion and usage conditions of the coupon.

discount_type.description: Indicates whether the discount is a percentage or fixed amount.

discount_value.description: The value of the discount, interpreted according to discount_type.

minimum_order_amount.description: Minimum order total required to apply this coupon, if any. Orders below this amount cannot use the coupon.

maximum_discount_amount.description: Maximum permissible discount amount for this coupon, if applicable.

usage_limit.description: The total number of times this coupon can be redeemed across all customers.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the coupon record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the coupon record was last modified.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking when the coupon was soft deleted. Null if the coupon is active.

IShoppingMallSalesSnapshot.description:

IShoppingMallProduct.ISummary.description:
Summary information of a shopping mall product entity available in the marketplace.

This schema provides a lightweight representation for listing products, showing essential identifiers, unique code, name, active status, and relevant timestamps.

It omits details such as relationships to sellers or categories for performance optimization in list views.

Use this schema primarily in product catalog listings and filter-based searches.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product.

code.description: Unique business code identifying the product, used in UI and backend operations.

name.description: Product name displayed to customers.

is_active.description: Indicates if the product is currently active and visible in the catalog.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the product was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the product was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking when the product was soft-deleted, if applicable.

IShoppingMallUser.ISummary.description: Summary view of a shopping mall user account containing key identification and status fields for listing purposes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user

email.description: Email address associated with the user account

status.description: Active status of the user account

created_at.description: Account creation date in ISO 8601 format

last_login_at.description: Timestamp of the user's last login

role.description: User role within the shopping mall system, indicating permission level

IShoppingMallSkuAttributeValue.ISummary.description:
Summary view of SKU attribute values in the shopping mall system.

Represents essential information about a particular attribute value of a SKU, including identification and display name. Used to provide concise details about SKU attribute values suitable for listings or references.

id.description: Unique identifier of the SKU attribute value.

value.description: Display name or value representation of the SKU attribute value.
