IShoppingMallChannel.description: Represents a shopping mall channel entity in the e-commerce platform that serves as a main entry point or marketplace, uniquely identified by a global code and associated metadata.

id.description: Unique identifier for the shopping mall channel record, generated by the system.

code.description: Unique business identifier code for the shopping mall channel. Must be unique system-wide and is the primary key.

name.description: Display name of the shopping mall channel visible to users.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this channel record was created. Managed by the system.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update made to this channel record. Nullable if never updated.

IShoppingMallChannel.ICreate.description: Request body for creating a new shopping mall channel in the platform. Contains properties necessary to register channel identification and display information.

code.description: Unique business identifier code for the shopping mall channel. Must be unique system-wide. Used as a global identifier.

name.description: User-friendly display name for the shopping mall channel.

IShoppingMallChannel.IUpdate.description: Request body for updating an existing shopping mall channel identified by its unique code. Allows modification of the display name while keeping the code immutable.

name.description: Updated user-friendly display name for the shopping mall channel.

IShoppingMallSection.description:
Detailed information about a shopping mall section within a specified channel.

Represents a subdivision of a channel grouping related products or categories.

Includes metadata like unique codes, names, description, ordering, and status flags.

code.description: Unique business identifier code of the section within its channel. Used in URLs and database keys.

channelCode.description: Code of the parent channel to which this section belongs.

name.description: Full display name of the section.

oneOf.description: Optional detailed description of the section.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the section.

order.description: Ordering index for display purposes within the channel.

isActive.description: Flag indicating whether this section is active and visible to users.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the section was created.

oneOf.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the section, null if never updated.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the section, null if never updated.

oneOf.description: Timestamp when the section was soft deleted, null if not deleted.

deletedAt.description: Timestamp when the section was soft deleted, null if not deleted.

IShoppingMallSection.ICreate.description:
Data required to create a new shopping mall section within a specified channel.

Includes unique code, name, and optional description. The channel context is derived from the path parameter, so channel code is not part of the body.

All fields must adhere to business validation rules ensuring uniqueness and proper hierarchy.

code.description: Unique business identifier code for the new shopping mall section, scoped to its parent channel. It must be unique within the channel and used in URL paths for identification.

name.description: Official display name of the shopping mall section. Represents the human-readable name used in listings and navigation.

oneOf.description: Optional detailed textual description providing additional information about the section's purpose or features. This field may be omitted or null.

description.description: Optional detailed textual description providing additional information about the section's purpose or features. This field may be omitted or null.

IShoppingMallSection.IUpdate.description:
Data allowed to update an existing shopping mall section within a specific channel.

Supports modification of name, description, and order fields. Code is immutable once created.

All updates are scoped within the context of the channel identified by path parameters.

name.description: Updated display name of the shopping mall section.

oneOf.description: Updated description of the shopping mall section. This property can be set to null to remove the description.

description.description: Updated description of the shopping mall section. This property can be set to null to remove the description.

order.description: Numerical order value to sort the section within its channel. Lower values indicate higher priority. Optional and can be omitted.

IShoppingMallChannelCategory.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for shopping mall channel categories filtering.

This request schema allows clients to specify search terms, sorting options, pagination details, and other filters to retrieve a filtered list of channel categories under a specific shopping mall channel. It enables selective and efficient querying of categories.

search.description: Search keyword to match category code or name with partial matching support

page.description: The current page number for pagination, starting from 1

limit.description: Number of items per page, default is 20, maximum is 100

oneOf.description: Field name to sort the results by, supports code, name, or creation date
Field name to sort the results by, supports code, name, or creation date
Field name to sort the results by, supports code, name, or creation date

orderBy.description: Field name to sort the results by, supports code, name, or creation date

oneOf.description: Sorting direction for the orderBy field
Sorting direction for the orderBy field

orderDirection.description: Sorting direction for the orderBy field

IShoppingMallProduct.IRequest.description:
Request format for searching and retrieving a filtered, paginated list of shopping mall products.
Supports filtering by product code, name, description, active status, and seller id. Pagination and sorting options are included to manage large result sets.

page.description: Page number to retrieve. Must be a positive integer to paginate through results.

limit.description: Maximum number of items per page. Must be a positive integer to limit result size.

searchProductCode.description: Optional filter by the exact product code of the product.

searchProductName.description: Optional filter by partial match on the product name.

searchDescription.description: Optional filter by partial match on the product description.

searchIsActive.description: Optional filter to return only active (true) or inactive (false) products.

searchSellerId.description: Optional filter by the seller's unique identifier. Useful to restrict product listings to certain sellers.

IShoppingMallSkuAttributeConfigurations.description:
Configuration details for SKU attributes.

Defines constraints, options, and additional parameters for attribute behavior and validation.

This is a reusable shared type used by multiple SKU attribute schemas.

options.description: List of possible options or values for the attribute if applicable.

required.description: Indicates whether the attribute is mandatory for SKUs.

IShoppingMallSkuAttributeValue.IRequest.description:
Search and pagination criteria for filtering SKU attribute values in the shopping mall system.

Allows clients to specify complex filters and pagination settings to retrieve SKU attribute values matching business needs.

Supports filtering by attribute code, value code, label, and status flags, with pagination controls like limit and offset.

Used mostly by customers to browse available variant options for products.

attribute_code.description: Code of the SKU attribute to which the value belongs

code.description: Unique code identifying the SKU attribute value

label.description: Display label of the SKU attribute value

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return in the result set

offset.description: Number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set

include_deleted.description: Flag indicating if deleted values should be included

sort_by.description: Field name to sort the results by, e.g. 'code' or 'label'

oneOf.description: Sort order, ascending or descending
Sort order, ascending or descending

search_text.description: Text to search for in the values

IShoppingMallCartItemSelectedOptions.ICr.description: Selected option details for a shopping cart item, specifying an option and the candidate chosen by the customer.

option_id.description: Unique identifier of the option being selected.

candidate_id.description: Unique identifier of the candidate selected for the option.

IShoppingMallCartItemSelectedOptions.IUp.description: Update structure for selected options of a shopping cart item, allowing changes to the option and candidate selection.

option_id.description: Unique identifier of the option being selected.

candidate_id.description: Unique identifier of the candidate selected for the option.

IShoppingMallCartItemSelectedOptions.description: Detailed information about a selected option within a shopping cart item, linking to specific product variant options and selected candidates.

id.description: Unique identifier of the selected option.

option.description: Summary information of the SKU option selected.

candidate.description: Summary information of the selected attribute value.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the selected option was created.

name.description: User-defined name for the wishlist to identify it.

IShoppingMallWishlist.IUpdate.description:
Data for updating existing customer wishlists.

Allows modification of allowed properties such as the wishlist name or soft deletion status.
Does not include immutable or ownership fields.
Use for authenticated customers to update wishlists they own.
Requires ownership validation in service layer to authorize changes.

IShoppingMallWishlistItemOptions.description: Represents a product option selected for a wishlist item.

option_id.description: Unique identifier of the selected product option

value.description: Value chosen for the product option

price_delta.description: Price difference caused by this option selection

IShoppingMallWishlistItemOptions.ICreate.description: Data required to specify a selected option when creating a wishlist item.

option_id.description: Identifier of the product option being selected

value.description: Selected value for the product option

price_delta.description: Price difference for the selected option value

IShoppingMallArticle.IRequest.description: Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering articles.

page.description: Page number for paginated results, starting at 1.

limit.description: Number of articles to return per page.

search.description: Text string to search within article titles and content.

created_after.description: Filter articles created after this date and time.

created_before.description: Filter articles created before this date and time.

IShoppingMallArticle.IUpdate.description:
Input parameters to update an existing shopping mall article identified by its UUID.

Allows modification of the article's title, body, and category association. The author or authenticated customer cannot modify ownership fields.

Security considerations ensure only authorized customers can perform updates. All properties are optional to support partial updates.

title.description: The title of the shopping mall article, must be unique per author to ensure content distinction.

body.description: The body content of the article, supporting rich text formats.

shoppingMallArticleCategoryId.description: UUID of the category associated with this article. Must reference an existing article category.

IShoppingMallChannel.ISummary.description: A concise summary of a shopping mall channel, representing a main entry point within the e-commerce platform. This includes unique identification code and name used for routing and display. Channels serve as organizational units for structuring sales and product categories within the platform. Soft deletion timestamps and state are managed internally but not exposed in this summary DTO.

id.description: Unique identifier for the shopping mall channel, assigned as a UUID.

code.description: Unique code used internally to identify the channel within the shopping mall system.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the shopping mall channel for administrators and users.

IShoppingMallChannelCategory.ISummary.description: A concise summary of a shopping mall category, containing essential identification and classification fields suitable for list views and reference.

id.description: Unique identifier of the shopping mall product category.

code.description: Unique business identifier code of the shopping mall product category (global scope).

name.description: Display name of the shopping mall product category.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the category.

parent_code.description: Business identifier code of the parent category if applicable (scoped to parent category). Nullable if root category.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the category was created if available.

id.description: Unique identifier for the article.

title.description: Title of the article summarizing its content.

shopping_mall_customer.description: Summary information of the customer who authored the article.

shopping_mall_article_category.description: Summary information of the category the article belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the article was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the article was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the article was soft-deleted; null if not deleted.

IShoppingMallArticle.ISummary.description: Summary view of shopping mall articles showing key information including author, category, and timestamps.

page.description: Page number.
